selection: Same lowest TRAIN seed per map as the closed MC study. Four fixed worlds. No outcome-based context or action selection. No new fitting or development use.
purpose: Compare one-frame and five-frame movement shifts under identical initial worlds/root actions and four shared future-policy RNG streams. Test whether longer actions provide a more repeatable benefit before collecting a new independent teacher. Four repetitions remain insufficient for general training admission by the previous study.
controls: Each context/stream: five-frame zero control vs fork-only reference with exact task/full proof. One no-fork replay per context vs historical ordinary baseline, always full exact. Exact initial state, prefix and root Gaussian/fire/category draws. All shared future Gaussian/fire draws equal; CUDA reconstructs all in-window samples including overlap with continuation fork. Unknown tail effects require existing independent completed raw-window proof, never zero filling. Source NN/std remain unchanged.
reuse: Reuse accepted old one-frame captures for streams1..4 unchanged, excluding near_stationary to retain the same four fixed directions. Do not replay them. Require matching zero controls across one/five collections at physical/task level before comparing interventions. Source original stream0 and streams5..7 are outside this comparison.
utility: 4*alive_goal+0.25*kills-received/100-death; paired against own same-stream zero control. Also paired long-minus-short for each direction. All four contexts are descriptive TRAIN conditions, not independent battle quality confirmation.
analysis: Report all raw outcomes and paired deltas, means, sample standard deviations, first2/new2 best-action sets with tie gap0.05 and fixed order control,left,right,forward,backward. For each duration choose first-half best action and measure its second-half gain. Report same-action long-minus-short effects for all directions without replacing failed contexts or seeds.
next: Only a passed technical and signal screen justifies a new independent broader teacher pilot with root-action conditioning and separately chosen replication budget. No fitting on these four states, no promotion; if failed investigate longer options or state/action-value learning rather than retuning development thresholds.
